empty.title: No containers to read
empty.text: This project has no Docker Compose project or pm2 app. Add one by editing the project.

exit.title: {name} · last exit
exit.noLogs: Daminus does not read container logs: they can hold tokens, emails and query values. Run this yourself to see the last lines.
exit.peakOnly: Highest reading {peak}; the container has no limit.

finding.oom: {name} was killed for lack of memory
finding.oomText: OOMKilled, restarted {n}× since it started; memory climbs to the limit before each kill. Raise the limit, or look at what {name} does just before it (logs command on the left).
finding.oomTextLimit: OOMKilled, restarted {n}× since it started; memory climbs to the {limit} limit before each kill. Raise the limit, or look at what {name} does just before it (logs command on the left).
finding.downText: Its state is {state}, exit code {exit}. Look at its logs (command on the left), then start it again.
finding.restartedText: It is running now but has restarted since it started. Look at its logs (command on the left) for what it stops on.
finding.hostMemoryFits: Host memory {used} of {total}, so raising the {name} limit to {target} fits.

perm.title: Daminus can’t use Docker on {host}
perm.text: The SSH user is not allowed to run docker, so there is nothing to read. Nothing is broken on the server.
perm.fixTitle: Let the SSH user run docker
perm.fixText: Add the SSH user to the docker group, then reconnect. Members of that group can act as root on the server; if that is too much, skip containers for this project.
perm.again: Group changes apply to new SSH sessions; the next scan opens a fresh one.

unknown.title: {name} could not be read on {host}
unknown.timeout: The check timed out. The host may be busy; the next scan tries again.
unknown.unreachable: The host did not answer, so nothing new was read.
unknown.missing: Docker or this Compose project was not found on {host}. Edit the project and pick the project name again.
unknown.unsupported: This Docker version answered in a form Daminus does not read.

unknownPm2.title: {name} could not be read on {host}
unknownPm2.needs_perm: The SSH user cannot talk to the pm2 daemon. pm2 apps belong to the user that started them; connect as that user or point the project at its PM2_HOME.
unknownPm2.missing: pm2 or this app was not found on {host}.
unknownPm2.other: pm2 did not answer, so nothing new was read.
